snippet.title: Touhou Dystopian FULL GAME - Youmu & Reisen Difficulty IV Gameplay | 3D Action Touhou Fangame
snippet.description:
*Touhou Dystopian* is a brand-new *action roguelite fangame* set in the world of *Touhou Project!* Strange incidents have erupted in the Animal Realm and Primate Spirit Garden — and it’s up to the heroines of Gensokyo to uncover the truth behind the anomalies and survive the chaos of this dystopian world.
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265060/__Touhou_Dystopian/

⭐ Big thanks to *Kay Lin* for providing me with an early copy of the full game so I could record this video ahead of launch. ⭐

🎮 Game Features
4 Playable Characters: Youmu, Flandre, Marisa, and Mokou
4 Support Allies: Reimu, Koishi, Meiling, and Reisen
9 Intense boss battles based on iconic Touhou characters
3D Action / Bullet Hell Roguelike with nearly 100 types of upgrade abilities
